Hi, I'm Shoya and I am a postgrad at the university of Chicago. I created my opinion platform Panjury as my undergraduate thesis and we've been using it as a way to collect data for academic research.

What is Panjury

Imagine a collective intelligence in which every human being can freely share the sum of all subjective knowledge; Think of Panjury as a "Wikipedia for Opinions".

Panjury is an opinion platform that can intelligently store, gauge and quantify the opinions on any topic that you share with it. It then returns the results to our users in ranked format. These opinions, when consolidated on Panjury, can support the work and research of many students and professors around the world.

Need Your Input

Unfortunately, the current usersbase of Panjury consists of only the UOC students & professors. And naturally we don't represent a large and diverse enough demographic.

I would help our cause a lot if you could go to our Panjury Platform and explore around a bit. Read some opinions and maybe even create an account and share some of your own opinions on topics you feel strongly about.

The opinions you share on Panjury will aid the development of this collective intelligence that we are trying to build. And will forever be held under a free license domain so people may use it for their education and research.

If you like our Panjury platform then please also share it with your friends and encourage them to to use it whenever they want to share an opinion.

Thank you for your time!
